title: Build the model-neutral Decision Flywheel
description:
Deliver a small, model-neutral toolkit that improves decision alignment from trusted labels. Start with the Decision Context Optimizer, explicit model capabilities, and reproducible policies. Then extract the existing trusted-feedback, learned-head, and human-reviewed steering mechanics from Jev-Flywheel. Dataset preparation and actual studies belong in the companion evaluations board.

Companion initiative: decision-flywheel-evaluations-049a2c8b-1798-5cf5-8a81-3cda98d0f924 in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues.

Completion: Jev/Kev/Laya capability conformance, automated development-only selection, versioned artifacts, fake-client specs, a complete offline walkthrough, and linked experimental evidence. The optional DSPy bridge must demonstrate automated optimization, not inference alone.

comments.text:
**New product definition (owner, 2026-10-01).** Supersedes the handoff above as the plan of record; the large static Jev study it pointed to is complete (Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations `studies/INITIAL_JEV_RESULTS.md`), and demonstration-ordering and Jev/Kev/Laya comparisons are deferred.

- **One flywheel, two optimizations** from labeled feedback, comments included: feature discovery (an analyst turns explanations and errors into rubric questions, as in Jev-Flywheel) and iterative optimization of one **fixed** few-shot example list.
- **Default end state:** a fixed, reloadable `ClassifierBundle` = optimized fixed example list + discovered rubric questions + trained head over Jev answers (2 Jev requests per item).
- **Dynamic per-item retrieval is separate and optional, off by default**, with configurable retrievers: lexical v2 (stop words on by default, negations kept, v1 frozen), in-memory embeddings, and design-only S3 Vectors / DynamoDB stubs behind one interface.
- Native, provider-neutral optimization only. The DSPy sentence in this initiative's description is void (withdrawn earlier; see AGENTS.md).

Core work is filed as two epics under this initiative:
- `decision-flywheel-6d3f7611-cb20-480f-b44e-b0317754bb13` Ship the fixed classifier bundle (Phase 1-2): `FixedExampleList` with reserve, Brier objective, `improve_example_list`, `ClassifierBundle`.
- `decision-flywheel-0276b251-e188-45c2-b7e1-4781a6222b7f` Optional dynamic retrieval (Phase 3): Retriever interface + config, lexical v2, in-memory embedding retriever, AWS store design stubs.

Companion initiative: `decision-flywheel-evaluations-258cd418-2a73-447b-9c78-5073fbf42959` in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/tree/main/project/issues. Design: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md
